title: Whispergeist
description: A breathy whispered formant texture sculpted from filtered white noise: a saw/perlin-swept resonant bandpass carves vowel-like breath that morphs across <a e i o u> while perlin pan drifts the whisper across the stereo field. Stays a hiss-edged whisper, never a clean tonal pad, trailing into room and delay.
code:
setcpm(88/4)
stack(
  s("white*2")
    .vowel("<a e i o u a o e>/2")
    .bpf(saw.slow(23).range(700, 3400))
    .bpq(perlin.slow(13).range(7, 16))
    .lpf(perlin.slow(29).range(2600, 8200))
    .resonance(sine.slow(11).range(8, 15))
    .noise(sine.slow(17).range(0.3, 0.8))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 1>/4")
    .gain(perlin.slow(7).range(0.42, 0.72).mul(0.62))
    .pan(perlin.slow(16).range(0.08, 0.92))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed("<1.5 0.7>"))
    .hpf(420)
    .room(sine.slow(31).range(0.55, 0.92))
    .roomsize(7)
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.62")
    .orbit(2)
)
